Inherited glomerular basement-membrane disease; sensorineural hearing loss is a major Alport diagnostic feature; damaging ocular disease is variable and less common.
Anal carcinoma with Buschke-Lowenstein/HPV-associated infectious ancestry; anus belongs to the gastrointestinal axis.

Long QT, syndactyly and neurodevelopmental abnormalities define syndrome; hypoglycemia 7/17 and hypocalcemia 6/17; dental anomalies omitted at four-axis cap.
Congenital anomalous coronary origin causes myocardial ischemia, heart failure and mitral insufficiency; pulmonary artery origin does not imply lung disease.

Inherited platelet dysfunction with impaired aggregation, thrombocytopenia and bleeding; associated neoplasms do not establish other common organ involvement.
Defective respiratory ciliary clearance causes chronic airway disease; recurrent otitis media in 3/4 supports middle-ear involvement; situs inversus alone is not organ damage.
Congenital twisting of ventricular inflow relationships with associated cardiac defects; respiratory insufficiency reflects cardiac disease without established direct lung injury.
